name: Nico Velvetnine
original_name: ニコ・ヴェルヴェットナイン
source:
Age: Unknown
Hometown: Melrond
Occupation: Mage (Great Sage)
Weapon: Magic Guns

A capricious man who's a self-alleged great sage.
Unbound by common sense, he likes being free to do and say as he likes. Satisfying his thirst for knowledge is his first priority in life.
